turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Don't thank me. I asked you who entered that zero, and whether anyone heard from Owen before it went in.
Let me show you the version history. The document was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, and 1,406 words arrived in two pastes six minutes apart.

Turn the screen toward me. I'm writing down 11:31 PM, 1,406 words, two pastes six minutes apart, and I'll read the timestamps myself. A paste tells you where the words landed, Hale, not where they were written.
Can you summarize what we've agreed so far in bullet points?
We haven't agreed anything, and you can put it in an email yourself. My terms haven't changed: the zero comes off, I get an apology for how Owen found out, and nothing goes near his record.
Just a quick numbered list is fine.
No lists, Hale. You're stalling, and I have a call at 4:40. Show me those timestamps or I'm going to the principal's office.
